Description: Summon forth your Ambulario, and ride in the delightfully fiendish spirit of All Saints' Wake.
Description{Enhanced}: Designed in the fiendish likeness of the Impresario, the leader of the Continental Circus, this automaton incorporates an enchantment which allows it to weave festive glamours. Its head also produces a satisfyingly sonorous bonk when struck, for a more mundane sort of amusement.
Tooltip:
Hello there, pumpkin!
Enjoying the festivities, I hope?
   - Continental Circus Publicist

Description: Summon forth your shagcoat cat, a gigantic-yet-gentle feline with a penchant for sporting a blue bowtie.
Description{Enhanced}: Native to Tural, this enormous breed of cat is regarded as a gentle giant on account of its intelligence and mild temperament. While those who have gained its trust are permitted upon its back, would-be riders should be prepared to get fur everywhere when it sheds its shaggy coat during the warmer seasons.
Tooltip:
Let us spread a love for
all things feline far and
wide across the land!
   - Neko Bugyo

Description: Summon forth your yan, a sheep spirit whose disarmingly adorable appearance belies its tremendous might.
Description{Enhanced}: Hailing from the Ninth, this unusually proportioned sheep is held to be a benevolent spirit that bestows blessings in exchange for an offering of diamonds. This entity in particular is especially genial and generous, and gladly employs its powers in service to your transportation.
Tooltip:
I believe diamonds
would be best for that.
   - Crystal Merchant
